Game Overview

Blockout puts players into a puzzle experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Blockout doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Blockout?

Blockout is a free puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Blockout free to play?

Yes, Blockout is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
